response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, m.facetfaces FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM matched), site_avgs AS (SELECT zoneregistry, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM matched GROUP BY zoneregistry, entrystat), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(face_avg) AS face_avg FROM site_avgs WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(sa.face_avg) AS avg_faces, AVG(sa.face_avg - b.face_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(sa.face_avg - sta.face_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_avgs AS sa JOIN status_avgs AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.face_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.face_avg > sta.face_avg
